title: Choose Stockroom's new visual world
question: Pick a durable operating-system for the catalog, or re-roll for another set.

options.label: Tabbed Reference Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals and acetate overlays
options.thesis: A living stock ledger where operational detail sits on clear, precisely indexed leaves.
options.viewport: An indexed ledger opens directly on the catalog, with health metrics printed into a tabbed divider rail.
options.risk: Needs restraint to remain fast to scan during dense product work.

raised.raise: Inventory health is also encoded in consistent line forms, not color alone.

options.label: Design Annual Plate
options.lineage: editorial annuals and production registration sheets
options.thesis: A calm, highly legible inventory desk built from measured grids and printing-room precision.
options.viewport: A single continuous inventory sheet makes product status and action controls feel intentionally composed.
options.risk: Its editorial clarity is familiar for polished modern workspaces.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes and calibrated signal benches
options.thesis: Stock becomes a signal: states are visible immediately against a strict instrument grid.
options.viewport: A live health panel anchors the table and turns stock thresholds into measured, readable signals.
options.case: Strong for stock health; less direct for editing dense product details.
options.risk: Can tip into novelty if the catalog stops reading like a practical workspace.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.lineage: industrial streetwear labels and stockroom tagging
options.thesis: A strict black-and-white operating floor punctuated by safety-orange product tags.
options.viewport: The catalog becomes a labeled work surface with bold literal zones and an orange active state.
options.case: Identifies with a stockroom, but loses product clarity to its styling.
options.risk: Can become louder than an all-day product-management tool.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean contemporary inventory dashboard, executed with care.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar dashboard structure with all essential catalog controls above the fold.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other SaaS tools by design.
